blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Verifying the final answer of a long reasoning trace may show that the trace is wrong but it does not distinguish three cases. The problem may lie beyond the model's capability, another attempt would succeed, or one step in an otherwise recoverable trace made the trace fail. Standard hidden-state probes are trained on final-answer correctness, a label that conflates these cases. Monte Carlo rollouts distinguish the cases and locate the failing step at additional inference cost. We test the hidden states of 4B and 8B reasoning models for the failure type and the failing step and compare each probe with the strongest baseline that uses no hidden states. On incorrect 8B traces, the confidence probe, a calibrated correctness probe at a midpoint cutoff, misses 81% of cases in which a single step makes the trace unrecoverable and 47% of cases in which another attempt would succeed. A probe with a different training design over the same states reverses the ordering of these two kinds of failure, so either ordering can be read from those states. At both scales, no single tested probe locates the failing step more accurately than a rule based only on trace length, and at 4B a probe trained to predict that step fails to outperform this rule in any of 10 runs on identical traces. The confidence probe therefore indicates that an answer is wrong, but its failure-type ordering depends on its training design.
blocks.zh: 验证一个长推理追踪的最终答案可能表明这个追踪是错误的,但它并没有区分出三个案例. 问题可能超出模型的能力,另一种尝试会成功,或者在本来可以收回的追踪中迈出一步就使追踪失败. 标准隐藏状态探测器在最终答案正确性方面进行了训练,这个标签将这些情况混为一谈. 蒙特卡洛的推出将案件区分开来,并以额外的推论成本确定失败步骤的位置. 我们测试失败类型和失败步骤的4B和8B推理模型的隐藏状态,并将每个探测器与没有隐藏状态的最强基线进行比较。 在不正确的8B痕迹上,信心探测器,一个在中点截断时校准的正确性探测器,错过了81%的一次步骤导致追踪无法恢复的情况,以及47%的另一次尝试会成功的情况. 一个在相同状态上具有不同训练设计的探测器颠倒了这两种故障的订单,所以两种订单都可以从这些状态读取. 在两种尺度上,没有任何一个经过测试的探测器能够比仅根据微量长度的规则更准确地定位出失败的一步,在4B级上,训练有素的探测器在10个相同痕迹的跑道中都无法预测该步骤的完成情况. 因此,信心探测器表明一个答案是错误的,但其故障类型的订单取决于其训练设计.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reasoning models can produce long traces that end in an incorrect answer ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . For these incorrect traces, the appropriate intervention depends on the cause of the failure. Some problems remain unsolved across many sampled attempts ( Yue et al., 2025 ) ; others are solved on another attempt ( Wen et al., 2026 ) ; and some traces remain recoverable until one step makes all later continuations fail ( Hwang et al., 2024 ) . A final label does not distinguish these failure types, and a model’s stated confidence is an unreliable guide to correctness: instruction-tuned models asked for a confidence score often assign high scores to incorrect answers ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) . A monitor therefore needs to identify the failure type and, for a trace that becomes unrecoverable, the step at which recovery is lost.
blocks.zh: 理性模型可以在错误的答案中产生长的痕迹(DeepSeek-AI,2025;Yang等,2025.). 对于这些不正确的痕迹,适当的干预取决于失败的原因. 在许多抽样尝试中,有些问题仍未解决(Yue等人,2025年;另一些则在另一次尝试中被解决(Wen等人,2026年;有些痕迹仍然可以恢复,直到一步使后期续作全部失败(Hwang等人,2024年). 最终的标签无法区分这些失败类型,一个模型所声明的自信是不可靠的正确性指南:指令调取模型要求的自信分数往往会给错误的答案分配高分(Zhao等,2026a). 因此,监测器需要确定故障类型,对于无法恢复的追踪,则需要确定损失恢复的步骤。

blocks.en: A trace is the reasoning the model generates in one attempt at a problem, and a prefix is a trace up to a given step. A prefix is recoverable if a correct answer remains reachable from it. Monte Carlo rollouts from each evaluated prefix estimate the probability that a continuation from it reaches a correct answer. An incorrect trace is termed a capability gap if it is unrecoverable from the initial problem state, and a near miss if it remains recoverable at every evaluated prefix. A pit is an incorrect trace whose first unrecoverable prefix occurs partway through ( Setlur et al., 2024 , cf.) ; the step that ends that prefix is its pit step . We test the ability of hidden-state probes to distinguish these failure types and locate the pit step without additional rollouts at deployment time.
blocks.zh: 一个痕量是模型在一次尝试一个问题时生成的推理,一个前缀是一个痕量到特定步骤. 如果能够从中找到正确的答案,则可以恢复前缀。 蒙特卡洛推出的每个评估前缀都估计了从中延续到正确答案的概率. 如果无法从初始问题状态中恢复,错误的追踪就称为能力差距,如果在每个评估的前缀上仍然可以恢复,则称为几乎错失。 坑是一条不正确的痕迹,其第一个无法恢复的前缀会分道相通(Setlur等,2024年,参见.);结束前缀的一步是它的坑道. 我们测试隐藏状态探测器辨别出这些故障类型并定位坑道阶的能力,在部署时无需再展开.

blocks.en: Hidden states carry information about the truth of a statement or an answer ( Azaria and Mitchell, 2023 ; Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ; Kadavath et al., 2022 ) , and a probe on the hidden states of a language model can estimate the correctness of its reasoning steps ( Ni et al., 2026 ) . Final labels record only final-answer correctness and do not directly supervise the failure type or the pit step. We train probes on the hidden states at a fixed set of layers, the read site , with three kinds of supervision: final labels; rollout rates , the fraction of rollouts from a prefix that reach a correct answer; and the pit step itself (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 隐藏状态携带关于声明或答案真相的信息(Azaria and Mitchell, 2023;Marks and Tegmark, 2024;Kadavath等人, 2022;),对语言模型隐藏状态的探测可以估计其推理步骤的正确性(Ni等人, 2026). 最终标签只记录出最终答案的正确性,不直接监督故障类型或坑阶. 我们用固定的地层,读取的站点,在隐藏的状态上训练探测器,有三种监督:最终标签;推出率;从一个前缀中推出的正确答案的分数;以及坑步本身(表3)。

blocks.en: We evaluate Qwen3 in thinking mode at 4B and 8B on hard mathematics problems from DeepMath-103k ( He et al., 2026 ) and the training split of Hendrycks MATH ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) . We use this model family because it provides open-weight reasoning models at two scales with a thinking mode ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . Appendix B gives the difficulty levels, the sampling parameters, and the seed and interval conventions of each measurement.
blocks.zh: 我们从DeepMath-103k(He等,2026年)到Hendrycks MATH(Hendrycks等,2021年)的训练分出(Hendrycks等,2021年),在4B和8B的思维模式上评价了Qwen3. 我们使用这个模型家族,因为它在两个尺度上提供了有思维模式的开放式推理模型(杨等,2025年). 附 录 B给出了每个测量的难度水平,采样参数,以及种子和间隔惯例.

blocks.en: 1. The confidence probe, trained on final labels, misses capability gaps and pit s more often than near misses. At the final step, the probe predicts the final label and remains calibrated at both model scales, but it misses 81 % 81\% of pit s and 47 % 47\% of near misses at 8B; a trace is missed when its predicted correctness at the final step is at or above a cutoff of 0.5 0.5 . After controls for four variables of the trace and the problem, the difference between pit s and near misses exceeds the prespecified minimum effect of 0.08 0.08 at 8B. At 4B the difference is nonzero and below the minimum effect (Section 3 ). 2. The combined probe reverses the failure-type ordering. The combined probe, trained on rollout rates of incorrect traces, reads the same hidden states at the same read site. At 8B the confidence probe gives a randomly chosen pit a higher final-step score than a randomly chosen near miss with probability 0.76 0.76 (the AUROC of pit s against near misses), and the combined probe does so with probability 0.40 0.40 . The two probes differ in training labels, attention mask, step weighting and training schedule, so the reversal cannot be attributed to the labels alone (Section 3 ). 3. At 8B, a failure-type classifier on transcoder activations meets the margin. The failure-type classifier reads the transcoder activations of one completed incorrect trace per problem and separates problems labelled capability gap from problems labelled pit . It exceeds the strongest tested baseline that uses no hidden states by 0.055 0.055 AUROC at 8B and 0.049 0.049 at 4B, so the 8B result meets the prespecified margin of 0.05 0.05 and the 4B result does not (Section 3 ). 4. No single probe exceeds the length rule at locating the pit step. The length rule predicts a late step from trace length alone. At 4B, the pointer probe, trained to predict the pit step, exceeds the length rule in 0 of 10 runs on identical held-out pit s. The ensemble, the average of the five pointer probes, exceeds the length rule under one of the two weightings of its failure-type loss. At 8B only the value probe, trained on rollout rates of recoverable traces, was tested, and it is below the length rule in each of five training seeds (Section 4 ).

blocks.zh: 2 失败类型

blocks.en: We describe the two collections of rollouts that supply the labels, define the continuation value of a prefix and the best reachable value, use a threshold θ \theta on the best reachable value to assign each incorrect trace a failure type and each pit its pit step, and state the evaluation protocol.

blocks.en: Two collections of rollouts supply the labels. The broad collection labels every incorrect trace at both scales. It evaluates steps 0, 1 and 2 and then every second step of a trace with 8 rollouts, and evaluates some of these prefixes with 16 rollouts in a refinement stage (Appendix B ). The gold collection applies the same scan to a set of 4B traces with 4 rollouts and refines with 8, half as many as the broad collection. The pit steps of its 818 pit s are the reference pit steps for localization. Each comparison is scored on one collection, because the two collections use different numbers of rollouts. Table 9 gives the size of each population and the comparisons that use each population.

blocks.en: A capability gap has no recoverable prefix; it is related to problems that remain unsolved across repeated attempts ( Yue et al., 2025 ) and to difficulty regions in which accuracy is at most 10 percent and does not rise with more sampled reasoning paths ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . A near miss remains recoverable at every evaluated prefix although the trace ends with a wrong answer; it is related to problems that are solved on another attempt ( Wen et al., 2026 ) . A pit is recoverable before its pit step and unrecoverable from it onward (Figure 1 ). Near misses and pit s are the incorrect traces whose prefix at step 0 is recoverable; we call them recoverable traces .
blocks.zh: 能力差距没有可恢复的前缀;它涉及到反复尝试中仍未解决的问题(Yue等人,2025年),以及精确度最高为10%且没有随着更多抽样推理路径而上升的困难地区(Chen等人,2024年)。 几乎误差在每一个评估前缀都仍然可以恢复,尽管追踪以错误的答案结束;它与在另一次尝试中被解决的问题有关(Wen等,2026.). 坑道在坑道阶下前可以恢复,往后无法恢复(图1)。 近去和入坑是错误的痕迹,其前缀在0级是可以恢复的;我们称之为可恢复的痕迹。

blocks.en: Capability gaps are the most frequent failure type at both scales, followed by pit s and near misses, and fewer than half of the incorrect traces are recoverable (Figure 2 ). For each step, a probe reads the hidden states at the read site at one token position, which lies at or before the last token of the step. blocks.en: On held-out problems, the confidence probe predicts the final label and is calibrated before temperature scaling at both scales (Table 13 ). Trace length, answer form and problem difficulty also predict the final label, so a probe can score well without using information beyond these variables; format variables have been shown to account for probe accuracy on a different prediction target ( Sahoo et al., 2026 ) . Table 13 therefore also reports the detection AUROC of the probe’s score after five such variables are regressed out, and a variant of the probe trained with the Brier loss, which gives similar detection AUROC and calibration.
blocks.zh: 对于被搁置的问题,置信探测器预测出最终的标签,并在两个尺度的温度缩放之前进行校正(表13)。 追踪长度,答案形式和问题难度也预测出最终的标签,因此一个探测器可以在不使用这些变量以外的信息的情况下得分良好;格式变量已被显示用于核算不同预测目标的探测精度(Sahoo等,2026年). 因此,表13还报告了探测器的分数在五个变数退后检测AUROC的情况,以及探测器的一个变体,该变体经过了布赖尔损失的训练,它提供了类似的探测AUROC和校正。

blocks.en: Among the baselines that use no hidden states, the strongest we tested for detection is the text baseline , a gradient-boosted classifier that predicts the final label from eleven features of the trace text, such as the frequency of verification and backtracking sentences, the position of the final answer, and the number and length of sentences (Appendix B ). A logistic regression on the same features has a lower detection AUROC, so a linear classifier understates the predictive power of these features (Table 13 ). The confidence probe reaches a detection AUROC of 0.81 0.81 at both scales, against 0.78 0.78 at 4B and 0.77 0.77 at 8B for the text baseline. The interval of the difference excludes zero and lies below the margin at both scales, so the confidence probe exceeds the text baseline without meeting the margin. Adding the confidence probe’s score to the text baseline’s features raises the detection AUROC, with an interval that excludes zero (Table 13 ).
blocks.zh: 在使用不隐藏状态的基线中,我们测试检测的最强标准是文本基线. 一个梯度-激发分解器,它从微量文本的11个特征预测出最终标签,如验证和回溯行句的频率,最终答案的位置,以及句子的数量和长度(附录B. 在同一特性上的物流回归具有更低的检测AUROC,所以线性分级器低估了这些特性的预测力(表13. 置信探测器在两个尺度上均达到0.81 0.81的探测AUROC,文本基线为4B为0.78 0.78和8B为0.77 0.77。 相差的间隔排除出零并位于两个尺度的比值以下,因此置信探测器在未达到比值的情况下会超过文本基线. 将置信探测器的分数加到文本基线的特征中,提高了探测AUROC,其间隔排除为零(表13)。

blocks.en: The confidence probe misses capability gaps and pit s more often than near misses at both scales (Figure 3 A; Table 11 ); a trace is missed when its predicted correctness at the final step is at least the cutoff of 0.5 0.5 . Overall calibration is compatible with this pattern by failure type, because incorrect traces are the minority of the calibration population.

blocks.en: We test the hypothesis that the best reachable value at step 0, V 0 ∗ V^{*}_{0} , trace length, answer position and problem difficulty account for the higher miss rate of pit s than of near misses. We first compare the two failure types within bins of V 0 ∗ V^{*}_{0} (Figure 3 B), and then fit a logistic model of trace misses on the failure type and the four variables. The difference between pit s and near misses after controls is the average marginal effect of changing a trace’s failure type from near miss to pit in this model (Appendix B ). It exceeds the minimum effect at 8B, at + 0.125 ​ [ + 0.104 , + 0.143 ] +0.125\,[+0.104,+0.143] . blocks.en: We call the probe trained to predict the pit step the pointer probe . It differs from the confidence probe in input and target: it reads a completed trace, which Proposition 2 , a statement about prefixes, does not cover, and is trained on the pit step itself. The pointer probe is a transformer encoder with bidirectional attention over the steps of a completed trace. At each step it reads that step’s hidden states at the read site together with those of the final step, and it outputs a distribution over the steps of the trace, whose most probable step is its prediction. The distribution is trained on the pit steps of the broad collection’s pit s. It is trained jointly on three further outputs, among them the failure type, which is trained on all incorrect traces with one of two weightings of its loss, inverse-frequency or uniform (Appendix B ); only the step distribution is evaluated.

blocks.en: At 4B, no single probe exceeds the length rule at locating the pit step on held-out pit s, and at 8B the one tested probe, the value probe, is below the length rule in every seed (Section 4 ). The hidden states may still carry the pit step; the tested probes do not recover it. Two limits bear directly on the localization result. First, each step’s hidden states were read at a position at or before the step’s last token, and for about half of the traces the position read for the final step lies in an earlier step (Section 3 ). No result was re-scored with corrected positions, so the localization result holds for these stored hidden states. Second, the pit steps are assigned from a small number of rollouts at each evaluated step, and the two collections assign different failure types to some traces they share (Appendix B ). The highest score that any predictor could reach against these labels is therefore unknown. We think the second limit dominates: the ensemble exceeds the length rule under one weighting, so the pointer probes read some information beyond trace length, and pit steps assigned from 4 to 16 rollouts at every second step may be too noisy for that information to raise Hit@ ± 2 \pm 2 .

blocks.en: All results in this paper come from one model family, Qwen3 in thinking mode at two scales, on hard mathematics problems. The failure types depend on the rollout protocol, including the number of rollouts, the threshold and the token limits (Appendix B ). Under this protocol, a capability gap records only that no sampled continuation reached a correct answer. A rollout counts as successful when its final answer is correct, so a continuation that reaches the answer through an invalid argument counts as a success. Such cases are reported for base models ( Wen et al., 2026 ) . The final labels contain grading errors, and correcting them leaves capability gaps and pit s missed more often than near misses at both scales (Appendix B ).

blocks.en: Probes on hidden states predict the truth of a statement or an answer ( Azaria and Mitchell, 2023 ; Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ; Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Orgad et al., 2025 ) , and on reasoning models the correctness of an intermediate answer ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Orgad et al. (2025) also define error types by resampling the answers to a question and show that probes predict them; their types are defined per question from sampled final answers, and ours per trace from rollouts at each step. A related study trains correctness probes on instruction-tuned models and one distilled reasoning model ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) ; the signal is decodable in all of these models. Steering along the probe direction in two instruction-tuned models does not raise accuracy consistently, which the authors read as a diagnostic signal. The internal signal is useful because verbal reports can differ from the model’s computation ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) . This paper measures the failure types that a correctness probe distinguishes.
blocks.zh: 关于隐藏状态的探测预测一个陈述或一个答案的真实性(Azaria and Mitchell, 2023;Marks and Tegmark, 2024;Kadavath等人, 2022;Orgad等人, 2025;),以及在推理模型上预测中间答案的正确性(Zhang等人, 2025a.). Orgad 等 (2025) 也通过对一个问题的答案进行再模版来定义错误类型,并显示探测器会预测它们;其类型是从抽样的最终答案中定义的每个问题,以及我们在每个步骤的展开中给出的每个痕量. 相关研究在指令调制模型上进行校正探测并进行分馏推理模型(Yuan等,2026年;信号在所有这些模型中都是可解码的. 沿着探针方向向两个指令调取的模型方向行走,并不能一贯地提高准确度,作者们将它视为诊断信号. 内部信号是有用的,因为口头报告可能不同于模型的计算(Turpin等,2023;Zhao等,2026a.). 本文衡量正确性探测器所区分的故障类型.

blocks.en: Uncertainty work commonly separates epistemic from aleatoric uncertainty ( Ahdritz et al., 2024 ; Abbasi Yadkori et al., 2024 ) or data from model uncertainty ( Ren et al., 2026 ) , and a recent account separates input ambiguity, knowledge gaps and decoding randomness ( Taparia et al., 2026 ) ; decoding randomness is closest in definition to our near misses. Behavioral work separates failures that resampling fixes from failures it does not ( Islah et al., 2026 ) , and a similar division is hypothesized for self-correction ( Li, 2026 ) . Under our taxonomy, the failures that resampling fixes combine near misses with pit s. Concurrent work predicts, from the output log-probabilities of failed rollouts, which intervention rescues a problem ( Islah et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 不确定的工作通常将认识论与孤独不确定性(Ahdritz等,2024;Abbasi Yadkori等,2024)或数据与模型不确定性(Ren等,2026)区分开来,最近的一个账户将输入模糊度,知识差距和解码随机性(Taparia等,2026;解码随机性在定义上最接近我们接近失手. 行为工作将重复修复的失败与它不修复的失败区分开来(Islah等,2026年),类似划分被假设为自我修正(Li,2026年). 在我们的分类学下, 重生修复的失败 结合了接近错失和坑 s。 同时期工作预测,从失败推出的产出日志概率来看,干预挽救了一个问题(Islah等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Process benchmarks label the first locally invalid step ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) or every erroneous section of a long trace ( He et al., 2025 ) , which differs from the pit step, and annotators can disagree about which step is wrong ( Jacovi et al., 2024 ) . State geometry can identify a first local error ( Alvarez and Baheri, 2026 ) , and attribution graphs can recover local validity ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) . Both targets differ from the pit step, which depends on the model’s continuations from each prefix, so an oracle for local validity need not locate it. Cui et al. (2026) and Yuan et al. (2025) infer step credit from final outcomes, which is a different target from the best reachable value (Proposition 1 ). Merrill and Srivastava (2026) locate commitment junctures by counterfactual resampling in strategic-deception settings. Among the definitions reviewed here, that counterfactual procedure is closest to the definition used in this study. Appendix A compares each claim with the nearest prior result.

blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We assigned each incorrect trace of a reasoning model one of three failure types from rollouts and tested the recovery of these types and of the pit step from the model’s hidden states. The confidence probe predicts the final label, and at the cutoff it misses capability gaps and pit s more often than near misses. The combined probe ranks pit s and near misses in the opposite order to the confidence probe, so an ordering of failure types read from a probe depends on the probe’s training design. The failure-type classifier, which reads transcoder activations of a completed incorrect trace, separates capability gaps from pit s. It meets the margin at 8B and not at 4B. At 4B no single probe exceeds the length rule at locating the pit step, and the ensemble exceeds it under one of the two weightings of its failure-type loss. At 8B only the value probe was tested, and it is below the length rule in every seed. The localization results concern the tested probes and read site; a probe that locates the pit step from the hidden states remains possible.
blocks.zh: 并测试了这些类型和坑道的恢复情况。 信心探测器预言最后的标签,在断接时它会错过能力差距并埋入坑来比接近漏出的时间要多. 联合探测器将坑s和相近的错位排列在信心探测器的倒序上,因此从探测器读取出故障类型的顺序取决于探测器的训练设计. 故障类型分级器(default-type classicers),它读取了一个已完成的不正确的痕量的转码器活化,将能力差距从坑 s 中分离出. 它在8B而不是4B达到比值. 在4B时,没有单个探测器在定位坑道阶时超过长度规则,而组合器在其故障型损失的两种加权法之一下超过. 8B时仅测试了值探针,并低于每个种子的长度规则. 本地化的结果涉及被测试的探测器和读取站点;从隐藏状态中找到坑道的探测器仍然是可能的.

blocks.en: For Section 3 , we fit a logistic model of trace misses on failure type, trace length, answer position, difficulty, and best reachable value at step 0, V 0 ∗ V^{*}_{0} . The difference between pit s and near misses after controls is the average marginal effect obtained by changing the failure type from near miss to pit while holding each other variable at its observed value, then averaging over traces. For the detection AUROC after controls, we regress trace length, difficulty, problem source, answer length, and numeric-answer status out of the confidence probe’s log odds. We score the residual on held-out traces and average over five seeds. Adding the confidence probe’s score to the text baseline’s features raises the detection AUROC by + 0.034 +0.034 to + 0.041 +0.041 across the two scales and the two training losses, with intervals that exclude zero.

blocks.en: Table 3 sets out the target, training traces, mask and model scales of every probe. The combined probe, compared with the confidence probe in Figure 3 C, has the confidence probe’s architecture, input and optimizer (Table 4 ). Its attention mask is bidirectional. It trains on correct and incorrect traces, taking the final label as the target at every step of a correct trace and the rollout rate p ^ t \hat{p}_{t} as the target at each evaluated prefix of an incorrect trace; the other steps of an incorrect trace carry no loss. It weights each evaluated prefix by its rollout count and each step of a correct trace by one, and the confidence probe weights every step equally. It trains for a fixed 8 epochs, and the confidence probe trains for at most 20 epochs with early stopping. The combined probe has a lower detection AUROC than the confidence probe on held-out problems at both scales (Table 10 ). Training the confidence probe’s design on the combined probe’s labels may help isolate the contribution of the labels; we did not run this experiment.

blocks.en: B.1 Failure-type classifier
blocks.zh: B.1 故障类型分类器

blocks.en: The failure-type classifier reads the transcoder activations at the input of the MLP block of each of layers 19 to 24, from the publicly released transcoders for both models 1 1 1 mwhanna/qwen3-4b-transcoders and mwhanna/qwen3-8b-transcoders on Hugging Face. . For each problem it takes one completed incorrect trace, the one with the lowest trace index, which we call the scored trace.
blocks.zh: 故障类型分级器在每层19至24层的MLP块输入时读取了转码器活性能,从公开发布的两种型号的1 1 1 mwhanna/qwen3-4b-转码器和hugging Face上的mwhanna/qwen3-8b-转码器的转码器中读取. 对于每个问题,它需要一个完成的不正确的追踪, 一个有最低的追踪指数, 我们称之为得分追踪。

blocks.en: Each latent’s rectified activation is summed over the trace’s tokens, at most 16,384, and binarized at that latent’s 90th percentile over the problems of the training folds. The binarized vector is projected to 256 dimensions by truncated singular value decomposition and passed to a class-balanced logistic regression. Gallifant et al. [2025] sum each sparse-autoencoder latent over the tokens of a text and binarize the sum at a fixed threshold before a logistic regression. The failure-type classifier uses the same summation and binarization with a threshold set for each latent.
blocks.zh: 每一次潜伏的纠正活性作用, 最多16,384个兆头, 二进制矢量通过截取单值分解并传递到分级平衡的物流回归而预计为256维. Gallifant 等 [2025] 将每个稀有的自动编码器相加于文本的标志上,并在物流回归前在固定阈值上将总和相加二进制. 失败类型分类器使用相同的相和和二进制,每个潜伏的阈值设定.

blocks.en: The label of a problem is its failure type in the broad collection, capability gap or pit . At 4B the population is a class-balanced sample of 1,722 problems within the difficulty range 7.0 to 9.5: 839 capability gaps and 883 pit s. At 8B it is all 6,372 such problems: 2,749 capability gaps and 3,623 pit s.
blocks.zh: 问题的标签是它在大集合、能力缺口或坑中的失败类型。 在4B时,人口是1 722个在7.0至9.5个困难范围内的分级平衡抽样:839个能力差距和883个坑s。 8B时,所有6 372个此类问题:2 749个能力缺口和3 623个坑。

blocks.en: The scored trace is not always the trace that set the problem’s label. At 4B it differs from that trace for 971 of the 1,722 problems. The scored trace is not a verified failure for 13.6% of problems at 4B and 20.3% at 8B, because of the grading defects described under Label corrections.
blocks.zh: 得分的追踪并不总是给问题贴上标签的追踪。 在4B时,它与1 722个问题中的971个问题不同。 得分追踪不是13.6%的问题在4B和20.3%的问题在8B得到核实的失败,因为Label校正所描述的分级缺陷.

blocks.en: The baselines use no hidden states. They are built from six feature sets: the question text with problem difficulty, trace counts and lengths, the question text with difficulty and the counts and lengths combined, the text of the scored trace, five statistics of the model’s own token log-probabilities on that trace, and the first five sets together, each fitted by logistic regression and by gradient-boosted trees. The strongest of these twelve baselines is taken in each repetition. Every model uses the same five folds grouped by problem, and the five-fold cross-validation is repeated with six seeds; the margin is applied to the mean over the six repetitions of the difference from the strongest baseline, and each repetition has a problem-clustered bootstrap interval. The same pipeline applied to the rectified hidden states at layers 19 to 24, summed over tokens, gives the comparison with hidden states; the transcoder input has 983,040 983{,}040 dimensions against 15,360 15{,}360 (4B) and 24,576 24{,}576 (8B) for the hidden states, and no random encoding of equal width was tested. Reordering the rows of identical inputs moves a baseline’s AUROC by about 0.01 0.01 . The text baselines and the comparison with hidden states address two results on probes of sparse features. Between 45 and 90 percent of the sparse-autoencoder features that activate more on reasoning text than on other text also activate when a few associated tokens are inserted into non-reasoning text [ Ma et al., 2026 ] . Probes on sparse-autoencoder features do not improve on logistic regression on the dense activations, on average over 113 classification datasets [ Kantamneni et al., 2025 ] . A linear probe on the hidden state of the last prompt token separates competition problems that a reasoning model fails under greedy decoding from those it solves, before the trace begins [ Zhang et al., 2025b ] . A problem that one greedy run fails can be a capability gap, a near miss or a pit under the failure types defined here.
blocks.zh: 基线没有隐藏状态。 它们是由六套特征构成的:问题难度、痕量和长度的问题文本、有难度的问题文本以及计数和长度的综合、得分的痕量文本、5个关于该痕量上模型本身标志性对数概率的统计,以及前五套组合,每套都由后勤回归和梯度起动的树所搭配。 这12个基线中最强的每一次都采用。 每个型号使用相同的被问题组合的5个折叠,并用6个种子来重复进行5倍的交叉验证;比值被应用于比最强基线差的6个重复的平均值上,每一次重复有一个被问题组合的靴子间隔. 同样的管道适用于第19至24层的被修正的隐藏状态,以符号为总称,提供了与被修正状态的比较;转码器输入有983,040 983{,}040个维,而隐藏状态有15,360 15{,}360 (4B)和24,576 24{,}576 (8B),没有测试等宽的随机编码. 重排相同输入的行将基线的AUROC移动约0.01 0.01。 文本基线和与隐藏状态的比较涉及稀有特征探测的两个结果。 45%到90%的稀有自动编码器功能在推理文本上比在其他文本上激活更多, 当一些相关符号被插入非合理文本时也会激活[Ma等, 2026]. 稀有自发编码器特性的探测没有改进密集活化的后勤回归,平均超过113个分类数据集[Kantamneni等,2025]。 对上个快活符所隐藏状态的线性探测将一个推理模型在贪婪的解码下失败的竞争问题与其所解码的问题区分开来,在追踪开始前[张等,2025b]. 一个贪婪的跑出失败的问题可能是能力差距,一个接近错失或者在此定义的失败类型下的一个坑.

blocks.en: With the stored labels, the failure-type classifier meets the margin at 8B and not at 4B (Table 6 ). The difference from the strongest baseline is + 0.055 +0.055 at 8B, with every repetition at or above the margin. It is + 0.049 +0.049 at 4B, with three of six repetitions at or above the margin. Every interval excludes zero and contains the margin (Table 7 ). The same classifier on hidden states at the same layers scores lower at both scales. No probe in Table 3 is trained on this label.

blocks.en: Removing problems whose scored trace may carry a wrong label raises the difference at both scales. The removal covers every problem whose scored trace carries a grading defect and, at 4B, every problem whose scored trace has a different failure type from its label. The removal leaves 1,294 problems at 4B and 5,078 at 8B and raises the difference to + 0.065 +0.065 and + 0.083 +0.083 . With these problems removed, every repetition is at or above the margin at both scales.
blocks.zh: 消除那些其得分追踪可能带有错误标签的问题,会在两个尺度上引起差异。 该去除覆盖了每个有分级缺陷的问题,在4B时,每个有分级缺陷的问题都与它的标签不同。 移除后在4B时留下了1,294个出问题,在8B时留下了5,078个出问题,并将差值提高到+0.065+0.065和+0.083+0.083. 随着这些问题的消除,每一次重复都处于或高于两个比额表的比值。

blocks.en: The removed problems are 62% (4B) and 65% (8B) capability gaps, and the baselines lose more AUROC on the remaining problems than the classifier does. The rise in the difference is consistent with two explanations that this analysis does not separate: grading defects that the question text identifies, and a subset of capability gaps that the question text identifies.
blocks.zh: 被移除的问题有62%(4B)和65%(8B)的能力缺口,基线在剩余问题上损失的AUROC比分类者多. 差异的上升与本分析不分离的两种解释是一致的:问题文本所识别出的各种缺陷的分级,以及问题文本所识别出的一系列能力差距.

blocks.en: The transcoders reconstruct the MLP outputs at layers 19 to 24 with a fraction of variance explained, pooled over tokens, of 0.338 to 0.525 at 4B and 0.366 to 0.564 at 8B.

The hidden-state column is the same classifier on hidden states at the same layers. blocks.en: B.2 Localization
blocks.zh: B.2 本地化

blocks.en: The length rule predicts t = round ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( L − 1 ) ) t=\mathrm{round}(f(L-1)) , and we fit the single parameter f f on training traces by maximizing Hit@ ± 2 \pm 2 and score the length rule out of sample; Hit@ ± 2 \pm 2 is also the evaluation metric of the probes. The median of t / ( L − 1 ) t/(L-1) at the pit step t t , the length rule’s scale, is 0.75 0.75 at 4B and 0.79 0.79 at 8B. blocks.en: The pointer probe predicts the pit step of a pit trace directly. It is a four-layer transformer encoder with bidirectional attention over the steps; at each step it reads that step’s hidden states at the read site together with those of the final step, and it assigns a softmax score to every step. Training minimizes the cross-entropy to the labelled pit step smoothed by a Gaussian of width one step, and inference selects the most probable step. The encoder has three further outputs trained jointly, a three-way failure type, a per-step estimate of the envelope and a confidence output, with loss weights 1, 0.25 and 0.5 against 1 for the step distribution; only the step distribution is evaluated in this paper. All 22,877 incorrect training traces (8,971 pit s, 12,692 capability gaps and 1,214 near misses) supervise the failure-type and envelope outputs, and only the pit traces supervise the step distribution. The two weightings of the failure-type loss are inverse-frequency weights (0.85 for pit s, 0.60 for capability gaps, 6.28 for near misses) and uniform weights; the step loss is the same under both. A held-out pit trace counts as a hit when the most probable step lies within two steps of the labelled pit step; held-out traces of the other failure types are not scored for localization. The run that excludes the gold problems trains on 17,143 traces.

blocks.en: The confidence, value, combined and pointer probes read hidden states at the read site 𝒮 ⋆ = { 23 , 24 } \mathcal{S}^{\star}=\{23,24\} . We select the read site by the detection AUROC of a probe at each layer, using the final label Y Y only. The selection measure is the detection AUROC in the middle step bin, computed within each difficulty group and then averaged, with a probe of the confidence probe’s architecture trained on the hidden states of each layer. The middle bin reduces both the difficulty prior present in early steps and the answer commitment present in the final step. Figure 5 A also shows the same measure for transcoder activations, obtained by applying the published per-layer transcoders to the residual stream before the layer normalization that precedes the MLP, with their activations projected to the width of the hidden states by a fixed random matrix. The transcoders were trained on the output of that normalization, so the transcoder curves do not describe the transcoders at their training site. No result in this paper uses the transcoder curves. We also record predictive 𝒱 \mathcal{V} -information [ Xu et al., 2020 , Ethayarajh et al., 2022 ] ; predictive 𝒱 \mathcal{V} -information peaks at layer 28 at 4B and at layer 18 at 8B and was not used for the selection. We record a usable-information measure because raw mutual information cannot order deterministic layers [ Pimentel et al., 2020 , Xu et al., 2020 ] .

blocks.en: The detection AUROC forms a broad upper-middle-layer plateau and peaks at layer 23 for both model scales, at 0.7264 0.7264 [ 0.7079 , 0.7445 ] [0.7079,0.7445] for 4B and 0.7124 0.7124 [ 0.6933 , 0.7295 ] [0.6933,0.7295] for 8B (Figure 5 A); the interval at the peak overlaps those of most neighbouring layers. The read site { 23 , 24 } \{23,24\} is not distinguishable from layer 23 alone because the four bootstrap intervals, the two at layer 23 above and the two read-site intervals in Table 10 , overlap. This selection uses one measurement per scale with no seed spread, and the two scales, selected separately, peak at the same layer. The upper-middle location is consistent with prior truth and correctness probes [ Azaria and Mitchell, 2023 , Marks and Tegmark, 2024 , Burns et al., 2023 ] . Prior work also reports that the best probe layer tends to be deeper in larger models [ O’Neill et al., 2025 ] , so we repeat the selection at each scale. Conditional probing measures only the information added beyond a baseline such as the first layer [ Hewitt et al., 2021 ] , and adjacent residual-stream layers are expected to be redundant. The layer-count sweep tests 2, 3, 5 and 8 adjacent layers centred on the peak. Two layers is the smallest tested layer count whose interval overlaps the interval of the best-scoring layer count, and adding a third changes the score by less than the interval width at both scales (Figure 5 B).

blocks.en: Table 8 reports the capability-gap share of incorrect traces for each problem type in the broad collection. A problem’s type is its DeepMath topic at the second level of that dataset’s hierarchy, or its Hendrycks MATH subject. The association between failure type and problem type is weak at both scales, with Cramér’s V V of 0.095 0.095 at 4B and 0.101 0.101 at 8B over traces with the stored labels, and 0.099 0.099 and 0.110 0.110 with corrected labels (Appendix B ). The DeepMath topics span a narrow range of capability-gap shares, with Discrete Mathematics above the pooled share and Calculus and Number Theory below it at both scales. The Hendrycks MATH subjects have higher capability-gap shares. The two sources also differ in difficulty scale, so this table does not separate source from topic, and the pooled V V carries the same limitation.
